audio._comment: device_index skifter naar lyd-enheder kobles til/fra (fx iPhone-mic). match_by_name=true resolver paa device_name i stedet, robust.

midi._comment_scale: CC#17 scale virker ikke i UAD - droppet. Minor -> relativ major.
midi._comment_retune: CC#18 = Retune Speed. UAD-mapping omvendt: 0 = knap HELT OP (autotune paa, sikker), 127 = knap HELT NED (autotune fra, usikker). Binaer - aldrig mellemtrin. Hysterese: op ved conf>=0.60, ned foerst ved conf<0.50.

detection._comment: accumulate-fra-start. Hurtigere: interval 1.5s, 2 ens vinduer, min_buffer 6s -> key (CC#16) sendes tidligt. confidence_sure 0.60 -> retune speed (CC#18) op foerst naar sikker. Reset ved 3 stille vinduer.

song_lookup._comment: Hybrid prior: Chrome-tab-titel -> MusicBrainz (titel->MBID) -> AcousticBrainz (MBID->toneart) -> laas CC#16 straks (provisorisk). GRATIS, ingen noegle. Lyd-detektion overruler (karaoke ofte transponeret). Retune (CC#18) forbliver NED til lyd bekraefter - prior styrer aldrig autotune-on alene. contact_email kraeves af MusicBrainz (User-Agent). min_strength: drop opslag under denne AcousticBrainz key_strength (0 = stol altid). GetSongBPM droppet (Cloudflare-blok).

cc_key_map._comment: pitch-class (0=C..11=B) -> bekraeftet CC#16 vaerdi i UAD Console (ikke-lineaer, maalt 2026-06-21)
